verdict.rationale: Rippling IT is a SaaS platform with a public REST API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers API tokens, scopes, version pinning, an SDK and an MCP server, but nothing describes a sandbox, test tenant or non-production environment. API version pinning and token scoping are adjacent controls and do not isolate production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
